# Data quality report — HeatShield Pakistan

*Generated by `make -C src reports` for the trusted run **20261020T150231Z** (finished 2026-10-20T15:02:33Z).*

## 1. Sources

| Layer | Source | Role | Variables |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bronze | Open-Meteo historical archive (2021-10-01 → 2026-10-10) | primary hourly series | T, RH, Td, wind |
| Bronze | Open-Meteo forecast API (`past_days=14`, 3-day forecast), fetched hourly | recent hours + forecast | T, RH, Td, wind |
| Bronze | Copernicus ERA5 via Open-Meteo (`models=era5`) | independent reanalysis cross-check | T, RH, Td, wind |
| Bronze | NASA POWER hourly (MERRA-2 based), 2021–2025 | cross-check + gap filling (≤ 24 h) | T, RH, Td, wind |
| Bronze | NDMA / PDMA Sindh / PMD PDFs | RAG evidence only (never model input) | text |

Units are standardised to °C, %, m/s (Open-Meteo wind arrives in km/h and is converted). All timestamps are UTC; daily aggregates use the local Pakistan day (PKT, UTC+5).

## 4. Data Quality Agent actions (trusted run)

| Rule | Records |
|---|---|
| overlap_resolved | 402 |
| cross_source | 62 |

`overlap_resolved` counts hours present in several Bronze files (archive vs. successive forecast issues) — resolved by priority, not a defect. `cross_source` counts local days whose Tmax differs from NASA POWER by more than 6.0 °C (flagged, not changed).

| Reference | City | Days | Bias °C | MAE °C | Correlation |

| nasa_power | Jacobabad | 1554 | -2.02 | 2.33 | 0.971 |
| nasa_power | Karachi | 1554 | -0.32 | 1.07 | 0.925 |
| nasa_power | Lahore | 1554 | -1.89 | 2.28 | 0.966 |

| era5 | Karachi | 1837 | -1.35 | 1.48 | 0.950 |
| era5 | Lahore | 1837 | -0.61 | 1.17 | 0.987 |

Independence: Open-Meteo's default historical series blends ERA5 / ERA5-Land / ECMWF IFS, so ERA5 agreement is partly shared heritage; NASA POWER (MERRA-2) is the more independent check.

## 7. Quarantine and audit trail

* Quarantined records are kept per run in `data/quarantine/<run_id>/` (1 run(s) with quarantined data so far, including fault drills).
* Every run, gate decision and agent action is appended to `data/audit/audit_log.jsonl`; run outcomes to `data/status/run_history.jsonl`; full per-run validation reports to `reports/validation/`.
* A run that fails a gate never replaces `data/silver` / `data/gold`; its candidate output stays in `data/_staging/<run_id>` for inspection.

## 8. Known limitations

* All sources are gridded model/reanalysis products, not station observations.
* NASA POWER covers 2021–2025 only, so 2026 days have ERA5 but no NASA cross-check.
* Three SOP pages (posters) and the Urdu page of the PMD alert have no usable text layer and are excluded from RAG.
